modelingNotes: Exact no-ammeter, no-auxiliary-contact, no-release variant verified in manufacturer Series 8527 catalog selection table, printed 10/13 (PDF 2): https://mega-ex.com/product_hazardous/Electrical%20Equipment/STAHL/10012015.pdf. Manufacturer-authored historical catalog, distributor mirror; undated copy.
Thermal adjustment 9-12.5 A, maximum operating voltage 690 V AC, 50/60 Hz. Current capability field 12.5 A is the adjustment upper bound, not an installation trip setting or wire ampacity.

Keys 1/2,3/4,5/6 are numeric main terminals, also shown as 1L1/2T1,3L2/4T2,5L3/6T3. PE is a functional authoring alias for the required protective-conductor connection; exact physical PE screw count/marking is unverified.

No C1/C2, D1/D2,auxiliary contacts or ammeter are fitted in this order variant. Three poles are ganged; functions do not create conductive shorts. Trip curves, backup-fuse coordination and hazardous-area installation are not evaluated.
Main terminals accept 2x1.5-10 mm² solid or2x1.5-6 mm² stranded, tightening 1.8-2.0 Nm (2013 manual). These conditional limits are documentation, not automated conductor-sizing checks.

connectionCoverage.notes: All six main terminals plus one functional PE connection are declared. Exact physical PE connection inventory and protective behavior remain unmodeled; no auxiliary hardware is claimed.
